correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact strong lumping of all injective labelled configurations yields killed generator [[-k,k],[r,-k]], with r=(n-k)/(n-1). Its eigenvalues -k +/- sqrt(kr) yield the two survival expressions. Positive eigenfunction h(A)=sqrt(k), h(B)=sqrt(r) defines the long-horizon Q-process whose hub switches occur at equal rate sqrt(kr), hence Poisson counts. Terminal survival probability of B is sqrt(k)/(sqrt(k)+sqrt(r)), and exclusion stationary probability k/(k+r); all three are strictly ordered for 2<=k<n. Independent direct enumeration of labelled states reconstructed killed and safe rows, including dense k=n-1 boundary; 79,396 separate row assertions overall, not an infinite proof.
